lead.headline: Phoenix's weather office logged 63% of the heat deaths in the federal storm file, then stopped filing heat after June 2024
lead.number: 1,345 of 2,145 US direct heat deaths in 2018-23 came from the Phoenix office; national direct heat deaths went 557 (2023), 250 (2024), 99 (2025), and without Phoenix they still halved, 205 to 98.
lead.watch_out: The drop is paperwork, not fewer deaths: Phoenix copied Maricopa County's counts from 2018 on and then stopped, and Tucson and Las Vegas moved deaths from direct to indirect in 2025.
